_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Yarr egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Yarr
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Yarr is a small, self-hosted RSS and Atom feed reader in the browser. Downloads the official release and keeps your feeds in one database file.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Yarr: downloads yarr from its GitHub releases, checked against
# GitHub's SHA-256. The feed database is never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "Yarr has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))."; exit 1 ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag nkanaev/yarr "$version") || exit 1
asset="yarr_linux_${arch}.zip"

if [ -x yarr ] && [ "$(cat .yarr-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Yarr $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Yarr $tag."
    gh-release download nkanaev/yarr "$tag" "$asset" $work/yarr.zip
    unzip -qo $work/yarr.zip -d $work/yarr
    install -m 0755 $work/yarr/yarr yarr.new
    mv -f yarr.new yarr
    echo "$tag" > .yarr-version
fi
echo "Installed Yarr $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Yarr version to install, such as 2.9, or latest.

variables.name: Username
variables.description: The username to log in to Yarr with.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password to log in with. Leave it empty to let anyone who can reach the port read your feeds.
